visual.pooling: spatial mean of final three backbone maps; temporal mean

sensor.scaling: training-only per-channel standard; missing values filled with training mean after scaling; observed mask retained

calibration: unweighted sigmoid logistic fitted to selected inner out-of-fold logits
threshold: maximize inner-OOF balanced accuracy over 0.01..0.99, tie nearest 0.5
permutation_scheme: independent circular shifts of labels within each recording/action stratum in chronological segment order; preserve recording/action prevalence; frozen folds; rerun all inner selection/calibration/threshold fitting
gate: Each branch: paired bootstrap lower 95% bound of AUROC and AP differences versus both prior and action-only >0; conditional permutation AP p<=0.05. Both must pass for FUSION GO. Intersection-union claim; no winner selected. Inconclusive uncertainty/control => CONDITIONAL, clearly unsupported performance => FAIL.
precision: float32 training; float16 autocast frozen visual extraction
